section.label: Exhibit 02
section.title: Little Things About You
section.lede: Not every exhibit has to be profound. Some of them are just the things that make you light up. These four are on the permanent collection.
section.hint: Tap a pedestal — or a little card below — to peek.
section.note: The most important food groups, according to Gioia.

items.name: French Fries
items.label: The Side Order
items.message: You get this little look when the fries arrive. I notice it every single time. It's one of my favorite things about taking you out.

items.name: Shrimp
items.label: The Main Event
items.message: You'd choose shrimp over almost anything, and honestly, I respect it. This exhibit exists because your happiness is very often garlic-butter-shaped.

items.name: Oishi Potato Chips
items.label: The Snack Shelf
items.message: The humble potato chip. You'd share the bag with me but pretend you wouldn't. I'm putting that on the record.

items.name: Pasta
items.label: The Comfort Bowl
items.message: Pasta is your reset button. A good bowl of it can fix a bad day, and I love being the one who gets to sit across from you while you eat it.
